📅 Daily Brain Teasers
- Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
- Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards.
❤️ Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone
Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind.
Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines?
Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

No scripted waves. No waiting. Just you, your rival, and a castle that won't survive the match intact.

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.
Your castle isn't just your base, it's your weapon. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes an enemy. In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart in real time, and the player who reads it best wins.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Blast holes through walls to create firing lines and collapse floors to drop enemy units. No two PvP matches ever play out the same way.
⚡ Real-time 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions where every shot counts and every second of hesitation hands your rival a new opening.
🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft up to 8 unique units: knights, archers, bombers and siege engines. Each one changes how you attack, the angles you threaten, and how you defend your keep.
📈 Deep upgrades. Level up units, unlock new perks, and reinforce the parts of your castle that matter most. The longer you play, the sharper your arsenal gets.
🏆 Ranked arenas. Climb from Bronze to Legend and battle real players on seasonal leaderboards.
🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards by upgrading your squad and stronghold. The deeper you go, the meaner the meta gets.
🎯 Play your way. Precision snipes, brute-force sieges, decoy walls or collapse traps. Every strategy can win if you execute it right.

CORE GAMEPLAY
Aim and fire from inside your castle using your drafted units. The walls between you and your enemy aren't obstacles, they're opportunities. Destroy supports to collapse towers onto enemy positions. Carve a sightline through three floors to land a shot no one saw coming. Bait your opponent into breaking through where they shouldn't. In Castle Busters, defense is never passive. It's a trap.

Win by wiping out all enemy units, or by turning their castle into rubble. Arena hazards shift your angles and destructible terrain means every PvP battle is a puzzle that builds itself in real time.

DRAFT YOUR ARMY
Knights to break the front line. Archers to punish exposed units. Bombers to crack open walls and towers. Siege engines to flatten whole sections of an enemy castle. Mix and match up to 8 units into a loadout that fits your playstyle: patient and surgical, or fast and chaotic. name: Yarn Loop
summary: Fun Yarn Puzzle Game!
description:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

description:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

name: Boom Crush: 3D Blast Fun
summary: Smash and blast through stacks in this fun crush cannon game adventure!
description:
Welcome to Boom Crush, a cheerful casual game with physics puzzle action. Aim a cannon at unstable towers and watch blocks, crates, and cans move, bounce, and fall in a 3D arena.

Choose a level, inspect the stack, set your cannon angle, and shoot at the weak point. A careful cannon shot can crush a support, trigger a blast, and send the tower into a chain reaction.

Physics Puzzle Challenges

Every physics puzzle has a different layout. Light blocks slide easily, while heavy pieces hold the stack. A low cannon shot may crush the base; a higher cannon shot may reach a protected block. Watch how the first blast changes the physics puzzle before choosing your next cannon move.

Cannon, Crush, and Blast Action

Tap to aim, adjust the cannon, and shoot. A direct cannon shot may smash one block, while a planned cannon launch can create a wider blast. Look for gaps and weak supports.

Objects tip, bounce, break, and crush into one another. A small blast can shift a stack, while a side blast can push a block toward another target. A central blast may open a path for a second crush. Every smash changes the scene. Watch the first smash, plan the next smash, and use a final smash when the stack is ready. One crush can lead to another crush, while a careful blast can prepare the next blast.

One smash can move a block; a second smash can start a blast. Watch the smash before the next smash and adjust your shot.

Colorful Stacks and Simple Controls

Boom Crush uses familiar objects in casual game levels. One physics puzzle may use boxes and crates; another physics puzzle combines cans, jars, and rubber ducks. Use the cannon to move a key block, then let gravity continue the crush. A careful smash can remove one support, while a wider blast can clear a row.

The controls are easy for casual players, but each physics puzzle rewards observation. Replay a level to test another cannon position, compare a low shot with a high shot, and find a cleaner route. An angle change can create a new blast path. If the first smash leaves a block standing, adjust the cannon and try again.

Relaxing Casual Games

Play a quick round or continue through more casual games. Watch the tower lean as pieces smash, slide, and settle. Every crush matters, and each cannon shot can change the result.

For another physics puzzle, adjust the cannon angle. A short cannon shot may crush one block, while a longer cannon launch can start a blast. Let the first crush settle, then choose a second blast or smash. The right cannon move can connect the next crush and smash.

In a physics puzzle, a careful blast can shift the base before a second blast reaches the upper stack. One crush can open a path, one smash can move a block, and another smash can finish the layout. Study the target, plan the blast, and choose the next cannon action.

Can you solve every physics puzzle, manage your cannon shots, and use each blast wisely? Aim at the weak block, start the crush, and enjoy this casual game.

Mustachioed Barbarians, fire wielding Wizards, and other unique Troops are waiting for your command! Enter the world of Clash!

Classic Features:
● Join a Clan or command your own with friends.
● Fight in multiplayer Clan War strategy games as a team against millions of active players across the globe.
● Test your skills: conquer the Clan War Leagues and prove you’re the best.
● Forge alliances, work together with your Clan in multiplayer Clan Games to earn valuable Magic Items.
● Plan your unique war strategy with countless combinations of Spells, Troops, and Heroes!
● Compete with the best players from around the world and rise to the top of the Leaderboard in Legend League.
● Collect resources, conquer and steal loot from other players to upgrade your own Village and turn it into a stronghold.
● Use your war strategy skills to defend against enemy attacks by crafting and building Towers, Cannons, Bombs, Traps, Mortars, and Walls.
● Command epic Heroes like the Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden, Royal Champion, and Minion Prince.
● Research upgrades in your Laboratory to make the Troops and Siege Machines you command even more powerful.
● Start crafting and building your own custom multiplayer PVP war strategy games through Friendly Challenges, Friendly Wars, and special live events.
● Watch Clanmates conquer in real-time as a spectator or check out the video replays.
● Fight against the Goblin King in a single player campaign mode through the realm.
● Learn new war strategy tactics and experiment with your army and Clan Castle Troops in Practice Mode games.
● Journey to the Builder Base and discover new Buildings and characters in a mysterious world.
● Turn your Builder Base into an unbeatable fortress and conquer rival players in multiplayer Versus Battles games.
● Collect exclusive Hero Skins and Sceneries to customize your Village.

What are you waiting for, Chief? Get ready to conquer, command, and start crafting and building! Join the action today.

Solitaire Grand Harvest ist eines der großartigen Online-Spiele, das von Supertreat, einem Studio von Playtika, entwickelt wurde. Es kombiniert entspannendes Kartenspiel mit dem Aufbau einer Farm.

name: Empires & Puzzles: Match-3 RPG
summary: Collect and assemble powerful heroes, build your base, and fight monsters
description:
Empires & Puzzles is an innovative match-3 puzzle game where puzzle-solving meets deep fantasy RPG, combining RPG elements, PvE quests, and base-building — topped off with epic head to head duels that range from riveting 1v1 Raids to large-scale 100v100 Wars.

• Match-3 battles with real strategy
Match Shields to deal damage and power up each Hero's Special Skill, then unleash combos at the perfect moment. Learn the five-element color wheel and turn the board into your weapon. Achieve huge combos to take down even the most powerful enemies!

• Explore richly themed worlds — plus many dozens of mythical quests
Prepare for an epic match-3 adventure that will take you through all sorts of worlds for a genuine RPG experience! Will your team be strong and sturdy enough to sail stormy seas, fend against underworld monsters, crawl through sandy dungeons, and slay titanic dragons — while also making tons of new friends along the way?

• Hero Collection
Hundreds of legendary heroes and dozens of mighty troops await collection — summon new allies to bolster your team and unlock new strategy options! Each hero comes with their own unique stats and skills — discover hero synergies and unlock their strengths to victory.

• Base-building
Rebuild the ruins of a mighty castle and turn it into your own war fortress! A finely built Stronghold will provide all the tools you need to gather resources, level up armies, craft useful items, train your heroes, and serve as a place of refuge as you fight the forces of evil.

• Play together
Join an Alliance and team up with other real players to get the best rewards in the game! Strong bonds will naturally form and evolve once you start playing together — whether it be fighting epic titans, strategizing in multiplayer wars, exploring treacherous islands full of monsters, or competing in Alliance Quests, you'll improve at the game, earn awesome rewards, and make friends along the way.

• Farming, crafting, upgrading
Make sure your team is well-prepared for all the adventures out there! Level up your Stronghold and gather valuable resources — such as Dragon Bones and Meteor Fragments — to craft legendary weapons that will help your heroes make it through even the toughest battles.

• Amazing graphics
This puzzle RPG is set in a beautifully rendered fantasy world — you'll marvel at the stunning details of countless monsters, dragons, and other fantasy creatures! Your heroes' powerful magic spells will not only dazzle your eyes but also dramatically turn the tides of wars.

• Train and dress up
Unlike in ordinary hero card games, you can level up your "deck" of heroes — and even evolve their power further by equipping them with costumes that add to their power! The vast fantasy world of Empires & Puzzles will present a wide array of challenges; you'll want to build an army that can tackle any opponent that comes your way.

Empires & Puzzles is the perfect game for:
 - those who get bored with casual match-3 games like Candy Crush and Royal Match
 - those who used to play hardcore RPG games such as Raid Shadow Legends and Diablo but didn't want to make the time investment
 - those who are looking for a new long-term game that can turn into a lifelong hobby
 - those who are looking for real connections with other players. The official E&P Discord server has tons of alliances searching for members and they might just be looking for you!

Empires & Puzzles has gotten over 100 million downloads and has unique and varied live events running everyday.

Start building your Empire today — download Empires & Puzzles and forge your legend!

Tactical battles await in this turn-based dark fantasy role-playing game, where you can summon hundreds of Champions from 16 playable factions.

name: Pixel Flow!
summary: Pig's Pops!
description:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

No predetermined routes. No correct answers. Just connection that builds over days and weeks — from awkward first messages to something you didn't expect to feel.

description:
Shape Your Civilization with 180,000,000+ Players Worldwide!
What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a war strategy game that fuses MOBA and RTS mechanics, featuring multiplayer competition and real-time combat?
What stories will unfold in a vast world shared by over 80,000 players, free to explore, gather, create, build, and battle?
Find the answer in Rise of Kingdoms, a battlefield unlike anything you have experienced before.

▶FEATURES◀
15 Unique Civilizations
Choose one of 15 historical civilizations and guide your empire from a lone clan into a great, unstoppable force! Each civilization has its own architecture, unique units, and special advantages — how you utilize them is up to you!

Real-Time Battles
Battles happen in real time on the map. Anyone can join or leave a battle at any time, allowing true RTS gameplay. See an ally being attacked right in your backyard? Send some troops to help your buddy out, or launch a surprise counterattack on the attacker’s city.

Seamless World Map
All in-game action takes place on a single, enormous map inhabited by players and NPCs. No isolated bases or separate battle screens. Never before seen on mobile “infinite zoom” allows you to transition freely between the world view and individual cities or barbarian outposts. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers and mountain ranges and strategic passes that must be captured to gain entrance to neighboring regions.

Exploration & Investigation
Your world is covered in thick fog. Dispatch scouts to explore this mysterious land and uncover the hidden treasure within.
Investigate lost temples, barbarian fortresses, mysterious caves, and tribal villages, gather intelligence on your enemies, and prepare yourself for the ultimate battle!

Unrestricted Troop Movements
New orders can be issued to troops at any time, offering limitless strategic possibilities. Launch an attack on an enemy city, then circle back and meet up with your alliance army to capture a pass.
Dispatch troops to collect lumber from a nearby forest and have them pick off a few barbarian clans along the way. Forces can also be split up between multiple commanders so that you can engage in multiple actions simultaneously.

Alliance System
Full alliance features allow players to help one another: live chat with built-in translation, officer roles, map indicators to coordinate strategies, and more! Alliances can expand their territory to gain resources, capture mountain passes and barbarian outposts to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements.

Conquer the Kingdom
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of this vast kingdom. Clash with other players and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in a MMO strategy battle royale. Rise to the top and you and your civilization will be written down in your kingdom’s history!

RPG Commanders
Call upon dozens of historical figures who will serve as your trustworthy commanders, from Julius Caesar and Sun Tzu to Joan of Arc and Kusunoki Masashige. Level up your commanders by defeating barbarians and sending them into battles, then upgrade their abilities using an RPG style talent tree and skill system.

♣  CHOOSE FROM THREE DIFFERENT CARD DESIGNS: German, French or Tournament card deck
♣  PLAY WITH TOURNAMENT- OR CASUAL RULES: both variants have their charms - just try them out
♣  FLAUNT YOUR SKILLS IN THE LEAGUE: rise up the ranks in our leagues and become a champion
♣  SUPPORT: our intuitive and easy to navigate app, various help sites and a great customer support will facilitate your journey to becoming a Skat master!

If you are a fan of other card games like Doppelkopf, Rummy or Solitaire then you will love Skat! Our game is and will remain entirely free to play, you may however benefit from in-app purchases to enhance your gameplay experience!

Let’s go - Download our app today and enjoy a thrilling new card game experience!
Your Skat Treff Team

Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.

Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring] 
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same] 
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

Deine Erfahrung auf TikTok richtet sich nach deinen Interessen. Einfach ansehen, liken und scrollen, um Videos, Creator*innen und Communitys zu entdecken, die du nicht kanntest. Von schnellen Rezepten über Gaming-Highlights und Modetipps bis hin zu Musik und angesagten Sounds – dein „Für dich“-Feed passt sich dem an, was dich inspiriert.

Mit TikTok wird das Entdecken zum Alltag. Finde Creator*innen zum Folgen, neue Ideen zum Ausprobieren und Produkte von kleinen Unternehmen und Marken aus aller Welt. TikTok bietet zusätzliche Unterstützung für Teenager*innen und Familien, damit du Zeit- und Inhaltspräferenzen für deine Familie festlegen kannst.

■ Personalisierte Entdeckungen
Ein „Für dich“-Feed, der lernt, was dir gefällt. Entdecke Videos, Creator*innen, Livestreams, Shoppingmöglichkeiten und Communitys basierend auf dem, was du ansiehst, likest und teilst.

Comedy, Gaming, DIY, Beauty, Sport, Musik, Lifestyle, Bildung und mehr. Finde Inhalte, die dich zum Lachen und Nachdenken bringen und dich etwas Neues ausprobieren lassen.

■ Einfache, leistungsstarke Erstellungstools
Du kannst Clips aufnehmen, pausieren und die Aufnahme fortsetzen, zuschneiden und zusammenfügen, Text und Sticker hinzufügen und dein Video optimieren – alles in der App.

Nutze unsere kostenlose Bibliothek mit Sounds und Musik für deine Videos sowie Filter, Effekte und kreative Tools, mit denen du dich ausdrücken und deine Videos hervorstechen lassen kannst.

Folge deinen Lieblings-Creator*innen und entdecke jeden Tag neue Talente. Teile deine eigene Story oder unterstütze inspirierende Menschen.

Entdecke angesagte Produkte, exklusive Angebote und nahtlose Shoppingerlebnisse, inspiriert von Creator*innen und Marken, die du liebst. Shoppe direkt aus Videos, LIVEs und über den Tab „Shop“, verfolge Bestellungen und genieße ein sicheres Shopping- und Transaktionserlebnis.

Starte ein LIVE, um mit deiner Community zu chatten, besondere Momente zu teilen und spezielle Funktionen und Vorteile freizuschalten, sofern verfügbar.

Nutze mehr als 50 Sicherheits- und Datenschutzfunktionen – von privaten Konten und Inhaltsfiltern bis hin zu Bildschirmzeit-Tools, dem begleiteten Modus und anderen Einstellungen. So bestimmst du, wie TikTok für dich und deine Familie funktioniert.

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: Microsoft Authenticator
summary: No more passwords, easier sign-in, and greater protection for your accounts.
description:
Use Microsoft Authenticator for easy, secure sign-ins for all your online accounts using multi-factor authentication or passwordless. You also have additional account management options for your Microsoft personal, work or school accounts.

Getting started with multi-factor authentication

Multi factor authentication (MFA) or two factor authentication (2FA) provides a second layer of security. When logging in with multi-factor authentication, you’ll enter your password, and then you’ll be asked for an additional way to prove it’s really you. Either approve the notification sent to the Microsoft Authenticator, or enter the one-time password (OTP) generated by the app. The one-time passwords (OTP codes) have a 30 second timer counting down. This timer is so you never have to use the same time-based one-time password (TOTP) twice and you don’t have to remember the number. The one-time password (OTP) doesn’t require you to be connected to a network, and it won’t drain your battery. You can add multiple accounts to your app, including non-Microsoft accounts like Facebook, Amazon, Dropbox, Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, and more.

Getting started with passwordless

Use your phone, not your password, to log into your Microsoft account. Just enter your username, then approve the notification sent to your phone. Your fingerprint, face ID, or PIN will provide a second layer of security in this two-step verification process. After you’ve signed in with two factor authentication (2FA), you’ll have access to all your Microsoft products and services, such as Outlook, OneDrive, Office, and more.

Microsoft personal, work or school accounts

Sometimes your work or school might ask you to install the Microsoft Authenticator when accessing certain files, emails, or apps. You will need to register your device to your organization through the app and add your work or school account. Microsoft Authenticator also supports cert-based authentication by issuing a certificate on your device. This will let your organization know that the sign-in request is coming from a trusted device and help you seamlessly and securely access additional Microsoft apps and services without needing to log into each. Because Microsoft Authenticator supports single sign-on, once you have proven your identity once, you will not need to log in again to other Microsoft apps on your device.

Optional Access Permissions

Microsoft Authenticator includes the following optional access permissions. All these require user consent. If you choose to not grant these optional access permissions, you can still use Microsoft Authenticator for other services that do not require such permission. For more information see https://aka.ms/authappfaq

Location: Sometimes your organization wants to know your location before allowing you to access certain resources. The app will request this permission only if your organization has a policy requiring location.

Camera: Used to scan QR codes when you add a work, school, or non-Microsoft account.

Read the contents of your storage: This permission is only used when you report a technical problem through the app settings. Some information from your storage is collected to diagnose the issue.

name: AOK Ident
summary: With the “AOK Ident” app you can securely log in to your AOK’s services.
description:
The "AOK Ident" app is used to create and manage your HealthID. Your HealthID is your personal digital access to the healthcare system. The AOK HealthID allows you to use health applications from your AOK and other providers, such as the electronic patient record (ePA) and the electronic prescription.

#Registration
Registration is the first step to obtaining your HealthID. Separate login credentials are not required. To register, you need your insurance number, a smartphone, and you must verify your identity, for example, with your ID card. The typical steps within the "AOK Ident" app are:

1. Enter and confirm your email address,

2. Set your six-digit HealthID code,

3. Configure biometric data usage,

and
4. Confirm your identity.

If you want to use a health application, you must also agree that your HealthID data may be transmitted to the health application.

#Login
Protecting your health data requires high security standards. Therefore, several factors are used: the Health ID code and the registered device with the app. You can use biometrics (fingerprint or facial recognition) if your smartphone supports it and the app deems the function secure. The app checks this automatically. First, set up biometrics in your smartphone's settings and then agree to its use in the app. The login methods available depend on the specific health application.

#Profile Management
You can manage your Health ID directly in the "AOK Ident" app. Among other things, you can manage consents, adjust biometric settings, control push notifications, change the Health ID code, and manage devices.

Do you have questions about the app or need help? Contact our support: https://www.aok.de/pk/versichertenservice/gesundheits-id-app-mein-leben/

########################

Are you a business partner (service provider & employer)?

The "AOK Ident" app is the foundation for secure login. It is the second security factor for secure and convenient login to our portals. Setting up the second factor starts either during the registration process or in the overview of "My Identification Management for Business Partners."

In addition, the "AOK Ident" app can be used as a secure method for personal identification. Identification is required to register an organization.

• Post your thoughts, photos, and videos with a global community. Join millions of users in shaping public dialogue across social, cultural, and political conversations.

• Discover Grok, the AI assistant powered by X’s real-time data. You can ask Grok to summarize trending news, explain videos, or give you more context about posts.

• Stream live video or go live with Spaces, our audio feature that enables you to host discussions, hold interviews, or start your next live podcast. Whether you're streaming a concert, a live game, or your thoughts on a hot topic, X keeps your audience engaged.

• Watch videos: from live breaking news and sports clips to podcasts and gaming sessions that last up to 3 hours long. Many of the world’s leading voices, in comedy, gaming, podcasting, and politics, all share their content on X.

• Connect and chat privately with friends, followers, customers, or collaborators through Direct Messages.

• Join and build communities tailored to your interests: from sports news, gaming, entertainment, crypto, entrepreneurship, tech, and more.

• Subscribe to X Premium to unlock exclusive features like a blue checkmark, boosted visibility, prioritized replies, fewer ads, longer videos, and post editing. X Premium also gives you access to creator revenue sharing and the ability to offer exclusive content to subscribers.

Why X?
In a world of constant change, X is your real-time source to stay ahead of the curve, connect with people, and explore diverse perspectives. From breaking live news and trending memes to top podcasts and live streams from your favorite creators, X brings it all together in one powerful social experience.
